name: codetask
description: Local-first AI task orchestration with pluggable agent CLIs and OS sandboxing
author: mrxuanz

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json --composite false && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start:server: node scripts/check-node-major.mjs && node scripts/ensure-node-native.mjs && node out/main/standalone.js
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-node-major.mjs && node scripts/ensure-node-native.mjs && node scripts/with-host-node-env.mjs electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:service: node scripts/check-node-major.mjs && node scripts/ensure-node-native.mjs && node scripts/dev-service.mjs
scripts.business:e2e:opencode-live: npm run business:e2e -- --operator opencode --providers opencode --case chat-basic --lang en
scripts.test:business-api-e2e: node scripts/check-node-major.mjs && node scripts/ensure-node-native.mjs && node --import ./tests/tsx-tsconfig.mjs --import tsx --test tests/business-api-e2e/*.test.ts
scripts.test:acceptance-contracts: npm run test:business-e2e-contract && npm run test:business-api-e2e
scripts.postinstall: npm run install:electron && node scripts/electron-mirror-env.mjs npx electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.build:unpack: npm run build:sandbox && npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && node scripts/electron-mirror-env.mjs electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run build:sandbox && npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && node scripts/electron-mirror-env.mjs electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:sandbox && npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && node scripts/electron-mirror-env.mjs electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:sandbox && npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && node scripts/electron-mirror-env.mjs electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:smoke: npm run build:sandbox && npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && node scripts/electron-mirror-env.mjs electron-builder --linux --dir
scripts.build:native: cargo build --release -p codeteam-sandbox -p codeteam-windows-sandbox -p codeteam-linux-sandbox --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:native:debug: cargo build -p codeteam-sandbox -p codeteam-windows-sandbox -p codeteam-linux-sandbox --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:sandbox: npm run build:native && npm run copy-helpers && npm install --prefix native/codeteam-sandbox && npm run build --prefix native/codeteam-sandbox
scripts.build:sandbox:debug: npm run build:native:debug && npm run copy-helpers && npm install --prefix native/codeteam-sandbox && npm run build:debug --prefix native/codeteam-sandbox
scripts.test:providers:light: npm run test:codex:light -- --case static --skip-live --role all && npm run test:cursor:light -- --case static --skip-live && npm run test:claude:light -- --case static --skip-live && npm run test:opencode:light -- --case static --skip-live
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/check-node-major.mjs && node scripts/ensure-node-native.mjs && npm run test:unit && npm run test:provider-contract && npm run test:workflow
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:fast && npm run test:business-api-e2e
scripts.release:test-gate: npm run audit:npm && npm run format:check && npm run check:third-party-dependencies && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci-scripts && npm run check:no-double-assertions && npm run check:architecture-boundaries && npm run lint:ci && npm run test:fast && npm run test:business-api-e2e
scripts.test:sandbox:all: npm run test:sandbox:tdd && npm run test:sandbox && npm run test:sandbox:policy && npm run test:sandbox:attachments
